content.text:
**Finding: missing (INSURANCE)** — no insurance clause exists anywhere in the Agreement.

- Searched the full document: "insurance" appears only in the revenue definition at p0012 (deductions for "taxes, freight, insurance"), not as a coverage obligation.
- Confirmed the two likely homes are silent: §14 Miscellaneous (p0120–p0133) runs Assignment through Complete Understanding with no insurance sub-section, and §8 Indemnification (p0085–p0088) contains only IP infringement indemnity with no coverage undertaking.
- Direction check: Corio (our client) is the licensee/customer; Commerce One is the licensor/service provider supplying the MarketSite Service, installation support, maintenance and training, so the covenant properly binds the counterparty.
- Redline validated (ok:true): new **Section 14.10 Insurance** inserted after §14.9, at the preferred position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Customer data is processed, workers' comp, certificates on request), with the E&O 1M / cyber 2M fallback offered in the comment.
